description: This Java source file defines an abstract class `LoggingActivity` that extends `AppCompatActivity`. It provides enhanced logging functionality for activity lifecycle callbacks and configuration changes, and manages UI logging through a `LogFragment`. The class initializes and stops logging, and offers utility methods for setting descriptions and background colors.

classes.name: LoggingActivity
classes.description: An abstract activity that logs all key lifecycle callbacks to the logging system and updates the UI log via a LogFragment.
